title: Calendar feed
description: GET and POST /calendar/feed, POST /calendar/feed/rotate (dayhand calendar, dayhand calendar on, dayhand calendar rotate): the feed, or null when it is off.

url.description: https address of the feed; the token in it is the only key

webcalUrl.description: The same address as webcal:// (Apple Calendar subscribes from it)

googleCalendarUrl.description: Google Calendar's add-by-URL link for the feed
